about:
Quality Manufacturing Services Inc. (QMS) operates from a 52,000-square-foot facility in Lake Mary, Florida, within Central Florida's technology corridor. The company was founded in 1995 and transitioned to an employee-owned ESOP structure, aligning every worker's stake with the business's long-term performance.

QMS delivers full-service electronics manufacturing, spanning PCB assembly, rapid prototyping, engineering support (DFM, DFQ, DFT), program management, testing (including flying-probe and X-ray), conformal coating, and repair depot services. The shop runs automated SMT lines capable of 01005 placement, nitrogen-purge reflow, and a PVA conformal coating system, supported by statistical process control across ten data collection centers.

The customer base spans industrial, military, medical, networking, entertainment, transportation, unmanned aerial systems, traffic management, and life-safety sectors. References include defense contractors, building security system manufacturers, and electrical test equipment makers who rely on QMS for both through-hole and surface-mount assemblies built to J-STD-001 and inspected to IPC-A-610.

Leadership emphasizes that the ESOP culture drives continuous improvement and personal accountability, while the AS9100-certified quality system and a dedicated Fast Track program compress lead times without sacrificing compliance. The company states its founding principle was to exceed customer expectations through technical excellence, superior service, and unrelenting tenacity.
